subject: confidence intervals around expected total scores from multi-group analysis

messages.author: cc6f459bb9b0129f
messages.subject: confidence intervals around expected total scores from multi-group analysis
parts:
Hi Phil, 

Hope this finds you well.  Am trying to get a plot of expected total scores with 95% confidence from a multigroup analysis using the mirt plot method.  Confidence intervals are not appearing.  Can you suggest what I am going incorrectly.  I am conducting a DIF/DTF analysis on a measure of 23 items, and setting anchors as the items listed in invar.final.set1.  

Here is the code:

group <- pooledat$group
itcol <- colnames(pooledat)[-24]
invar.final.set1 <- itcol[c(2,8,13,14,16,18,20,22,23)]
dif.final.set1 <- c(1,3:7,9:12,15,17,19,21)

remove(modMG_final.set1)
modMG_final.set1 <- multipleGroup(pooledat[itcol], 1, group, SE=T,
                 invariance = c(invar.final.set1,
                                           'free_mean',
                                           'free_var'),
                            technical = list(NCYCLES = 2000))
plot(modMG_final.set1,MI=2000)

data is attached.

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: confidence intervals around expected total scores from multi-group analysis
parts:
Hi Cathy,

The plot() generic doesn't support the MI input for multiplegroup objects, so a warning message should have been printed (added on the dev). That said, the plot you want lives inside the DRF() function and can be computed via:

DRF(modMG_final.set1, draws = 500, plot = TRUE)

This provides the difference between the two expected response functions along with their condition 95% CIs. HTH.

Phil
